claude.result:
All changes look focused and minimal. Summary of the fix:

- **`packages/frai-core/src/scanners/imports.js`** (new): parses actual import/require specifiers from JS/TS/JSX/TSX/MJS/CJS/MTS/CTS content (handles `import … from`, bare `import '…'`, `export … from`, `require(...)`, dynamic `import(...)`, multi-line and `import type`) and from Python-style content (`import a, b as c`, `import pkg.sub`, `from pkg.sub import x`, skipping relative imports). Comments (`//`, `/* */`, `#`) are stripped with quote-awareness first so commented-out lines never match.
- **`packages/frai-core/src/scanners/detectors.js`**: `createLibraryDetector` now extracts real module specifiers per file extension and matches a library only on exact name or `name/…` / `name.…` submodule boundaries — fixing both the missed detections (e.g. `import OpenAI from 'openai'`) and false positives like `openai-mock` or `caretaker` matching `caret`. Custom library arrays passed in keep working since the matching logic is library-list agnostic.
- **`packages/frai-core/src/scanners/constants.js`**: added `openai`, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `langchain`, `@langchain` to the default AI library list, and `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.mts`, `.cts` to the scanned extensions.
- **`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`** (+ rebuilt `dist/index.js`): `frai scan` now takes `[directory]`, resolves and validates it exists as a directory, and exits non-zero with an error message if not.
- Added regression tests in `scan-codebase.test.js` covering the support-triage-demo example, all the new JS/TS import forms across the new extensions, boundary/comment/relative-import exclusions, and the Python import forms.

Full `vitest run` still shows the same two pre-existing unrelated failures (`eval` and `finetune/governance`); everything else, including the new tests, passes.
